votes.refutation: I first checked both stated premises. The non-GitHub scenario is refuted: installation_id is read-only and provider immutable at presentation/serializers.py:61-63,98-103; sync creates/adopts only GitHub rows at presentation/views.py:85-99,307-315, and only those rows receive connected_by_user_id. A fresh sync also creates repos disabled, so sync alone need not make the flag true. However, an already-enabled resynced repo, or an enabled repo read before replication catches up, still exposes the reader/writer mismatch. This is a minor temporary UI consistency issue with reload as a workaround, not a provider-support or worker-correctness defect; hence consider rather than should_fix.
